subject: [PATCH 4/4] kernfs: Remove kernfs_rwsem from dentry revalidation

reviews.author: Shakeel Butt
reviews.summary: Raised concern that reclaim cannot set dentry->d_inode = NULL for a dentry with elevated d_lockref.count due to kernfs_dop_revalidate getting the dentry

2026-09-12.patch_summary: Patch aims to remove kernfs_rwsem from dentry revalidation, but reviewer raises concerns about reclaim setting dentry->d_inode = NULL for elevated dentry->d_lockref.count
